requested_order: evaluate data quality including formation following gaps, TTC, per-vehicle behavior, and unlock-state fraction
merge the current branch into BEV only after data quality passes

resolved_plan.precondition: Complete candidate-v3 fixed-five-seed scenario acceptance and freeze a new scenario contract before collection.

pilot_default.reason: A 5k balanced pilot is 10 percent of the formal target and gives more stable per-scenario and per-role quality estimates than the previous 1k format-only pilot.

resolved_plan.formal_50k_policy: Collect from the clean merged BEV commit into a new empty root; do not resume or mix the historical v1 root or the pilot root.
resolved_plan.stage1_policy: Train Stage1-A only after the new candidate-v3 50k dataset passes complete verification and the frozen quality gate.

quality_scope: bundle integrity, schema, joins, fingerprints, splits, and S5-S9 balance
collision, out-of-road, 5 m background-gap and 7 m platoon-gap violations
TTC by ego role, actor class, and scenario semantics
leader-middle and middle-rear following gaps and locked desired-gap error
formation release, recovery, order preservation, and persistence
leader, middle, and rear behavior/mode, speed, acceleration, jerk, and lane-transition distributions
LOCKED/UNLOCKED step fractions, trigger rate and cause, duration, relock rate, and relock latency
scenario-required behavior coverage and exactly 3-6 incidental actors per episode
duplicate, missing, corrupt, NaN/Inf, leakage, imbalance, and unobserved-mode risks
hard_boundaries: Freeze exact numeric thresholds before pilot collection and do not tune them after observing the pilot.
Evaluate designated conflict TTC separately from incidental-background TTC.
Do not merge or collect 50k when any hard pilot gate fails.
Do not modify code, scenario, policy, schema, collector, split, or threshold semantics during collection.
Do not mark the historical formal50k_v1 dataset as candidate-v3 data.
next_action: Run and review the candidate-v3 S5-S9 fixed-five-seed acceptance, then freeze the pilot config and exact quality thresholds.
